shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
circular disc ornament at the chest/neck
small circular ear or side ornament
incised outline drawing with plain (uninfilled) areas
banded/striated panel of parallel lines across the lower body
figure shown from the waist or torso up
justification: Both depict a single dominant anthropomorphic figure with a broad headdress over the crown, a round disc ornament at the neck/chest and a round ear-level element, all rendered as bare incised outlines with striated bands over the lower torso. The clearest difference is orientation and completeness: A presents a massive frontal, symmetrical figure with the incised motifs spread over a sculptural body, while B shows a strict profile head-and-shoulders with a wing-like fan of parallel lines, so the specific combination of motifs is only loosely parallel.
